mandatoryCriteria: Dual runtime harness: Hono application mounts and executes identically on Node.js and Cloudflare Workers (workerd)
Database dependency injection: Both runtimes receive real database connection dependencies; health checks and product routes use the injected dependency
Health and readiness probes: /health/live returns 200 ok; /health/ready probes database connection and returns 200 ready (or safe 503 DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE)
Graceful shutdown: Node runtime closes server and ends pool cleanly
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: Node.js and Cloudflare Workers runtime harnesses, health probes, and pool lifecycle. Out-of-scope: Cloudflare Hyperdrive production credentials.
